newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong ups price on Kingswood Villa.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong ups price on Kingswood Villa.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it would offer an additional 72 units in its Kingswood Villa residential development for sale at HK$4,212 per square foot, versus an initial price of HK$4,089 per sq ft.

Cheung Kong said in a statement there were 800 potential buyers registered to buy an initial 48 units on offer following the first day of registration on Tuesday, representing 15 times the number of flats put for sale.
The registration will run till March 28 and the units would be sold through a ballot on March 30.
The units opened for sale were in the last phase of the company's Kingswood Villa development in Tin Shui Wei in Hong Kong's New Territories, it said.
